lesson.subtitle: Lesson 23 -- Since 1998
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 23 -- Since 1998
lesson.grammar_point: past simple of high-frequency irregular verbs: went, had, made, got, took, began (affirmative)

listenings.text: Hi Ricardo, it's Linda. Thank you for the meeting today. You know, my career began in New York, in 1995. I was a trader for ten years. Then I went to London, and I had a great job at a big bank. In 2012, I took a job here in Miami. And now I have a fantastic team. See you tomorrow at nine!

Hi, it's Paul. My first job was not at a bank. I was a teacher! I had a small class in Texas, with twenty kids. Then, in 2005, I went to university again, at night. I took an MBA. In 2008, I got a job here, on the fourth floor. I made a lot of new friends. So my career began two times!

extra_audio.text: My career began in 1998. I was an intern at a bank. I went to university at night. In 2003, I got a job as a trader. In 2015, I got a promotion.
